timeline.summary: U.K. Paints (India) Private Limited, on behalf of Berger Paints (India) Limited’s promoter group, declared no encumbrances on held shares during FY2025-26.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,868.03 Cr (+6.1% YoY), net profit ₹335.25 Cr (+27.5% YoY).
Released the audio recording of the Q4FY26 investor presentation on May 12, 2026.
CB Management Services Private Limited amalgamated into MUFG Intime India Private Limited with effect from May 8, 2026.
On May 14, 2026, Berger Paints filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 investor presentation held on May 12, 2026.
Berger Paints Q1FY27 call: 8.4% volume growth, 12.7% value growth, decorative up 13.5%; FY27 capex guided at ₹600-800 Cr.
